provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Eldritch Horror rules summary (Fantasy Flight Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Choose an Ancient One sheet together and resolve its setup effect
Each player picks an investigator: sheet, token and stand; token on its starting space
Starting possessions from the back of the sheet; Health and Sanity tokens at their maximums
Decks: Expedition Encounters shuffled together; Spells and Conditions as two faceup decks; the rest shuffled by card back; Mythos cards aside
All Monster tokens in an opaque Monster cup
4 Asset cards faceup in the reserve
Build the Mythos deck as the bottom of the Ancient One sheet instructs
Reference card for your player count by the Mythos deck
Doom token on the space the Ancient One lists; Omen token on the green comet space
Starting with the Lead Investigator and going clockwise, each investigator takes up to two actions
